question: Get details of repositories that use specific feature toggle libraries. For each repository, include the full name with owner, hosting platform type, size in bytes, primary programming language, fork source name (if any), last update timestamp, the artifact and library names of the feature toggle used, and the library's programming languages. SELECT DISTINCT
    prf.repository_name_with_owner as repository_full_name,
    prf.repository_host_type as hosting_platform_type,
    prf.repository_size * 1024 as size_in_bytes,
    prf.repository_language as primary_programming_language,
    prf.repository_fork_source_name_with_owner as fork_source_name,
    prf.repository_updated_timestamp as last_update_timestamp,
    ftl.artifact_name,
    ftl.library_name,
    ftl.languages as library_languages
FROM `bigquery-public-data.libraries_io.dependencies` d
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.libraries_io.projects` p 
    ON d.dependency_project_id = p.id
JOIN feature_toggle_libs ftl
    ON p.name = ftl.artifact_name
    AND p.platform = ftl.platform
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.libraries_io.projects_with_repository_fields` prf
    ON d.project_name = prf.name
    AND d.platform = prf.platform
ORDER BY prf.repository_name_with_owner, ftl.artifact_name
